findingDetails.title: Maintained CLI READMEs retain retired scripts topology
findingDetails.evidence: Several current runtime/cli README files describe their own directories as scripts/* and link to retired memory paths, while the package root is runtime/cli and continuity is the current folder.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rewrite current subordinate README topology and links to runtime/cli and continuity vocabulary.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct reads across ten current runtime/cli README surfaces.

findingDetails.title: Script registry mixes current paths with stale dependency vocabulary
findingDetails.evidence: Primary registry paths use runtime/cli, but dependency and output fields retain lib/*.js and memory naming that no longer match the moved source and continuity topology.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reconcile registry dependency and category metadata with the current source and continuity names.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct registry read plus current CLI source layout.

results.summary: Current subordinate documentation does not consistently describe the current package topology.
Registry correctness is not covered by the broad summary evidence.
Catalog paths are current but subordinate docs drift.
Operator documentation mixes current commands with retired topology descriptions.

noveltyJustification: The pass widened the stale-topology issue from isolated docs to the maintained registry and current operator pages.
